questions.prompt: Mediate the familiar request for help. Clarify what is requested, restate each concern and propose a next step that does not pretend the disagreement has vanished.
questions.context:
A asks a companion to explain a message today, worrying that an unanswered message will be misunderstood. B worries that the task may require knowledge they lack and has not agreed. It is unclear which part needs explaining. Clarify the request, restate both concerns, and propose checking that part first; no agreement to complete the whole task exists.
Familiar meanings available: occasion; setting; to call; to address as; to request help; to appeal; explanation; to explain.
questions.label: Take your speaking turn

rubric.text: I clarified the actual request and both concerns.
My proposal addresses the concerns and acknowledges what remains unresolved.

questions.prompt: Write a synthesis of the two familiar accounts of the request for help. Separate what each source states from your interpretation and preserve the remaining uncertainty.
questions.context:
Account A: a companion requested help and received no answer, so A thinks the recipient refused. Account B: the recipient may not have understood the request; B has no confirmation. Both accounts report no answer. Write a synthesis that attributes each interpretation and preserves the unknown intention and understanding.
Familiar meanings available: to request help; to appeal; companion; comrade; according to; to act in accordance with; to believe; to think.
questions.label: Write your own message

rubric.text: My synthesis preserves qualifications and labels my interpretation.
